title: SpaceDomainVerifiedPayload
description: space.domain.verified v1 (OpenVibe.Space, subject domain dom_…, visibility internal): a custom domain's TXT record (_openvibe-space.<hostname>) was found, and the domain now serves the site.

site.description: the site name (one DNS label; the site is served at <site>.openvibe.website)

hostname.description: the custom domain, a fully qualified host name in lower case
